title: Global well-posedness of the Toda lattice on an exact spectral phase space
summary: We identify an exact spectral phase space for the two-sided Toda lattice. Let $q=\{a_n,b_n\}_{n\in\mathbb Z}$ be coefficients of the right and left half-line Jacobi operators and denote their spectral measures by $σ_{\pm}^{q}$. Define a phase space \[ \mathcal Q=\left\{ \begin{array} [c]{c}% q=\{a_n,b_n\}_{n\in\mathbb Z}: a_n>0,\ b_{n} \in \mathbb{R} \text{ and} \int_{\mathbb R}e^{c|λ|}σ^q_\pm(dλ) 0 \end{array} \right\} . \] The integrability condition makes the representing measures unique.
